book.name: Madiyu
book.title: To Nafa We Madiyu E Sa꞉sa꞉lo꞉

content: Ya꞉su Kelisowa꞉ e ma꞉mu i ko꞉lo꞉ mio꞉wo꞉ we
Ya꞉su Keliso e Da꞉ibid eya a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Ablahama꞉ so꞉lo꞉wa a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉. Ya꞉su Kelisowa꞉ ene so꞉lo꞉ mio꞉wo꞉ we.
Ablahama꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Aisa꞉g, Aisa꞉ga꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Ya꞉kob Ya꞉koba꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Yuda, a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ ene ao i nolo꞉lo꞉ a꞉lab.
Yudaya꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Beles o꞉lia꞉ Sa꞉la o꞉lia꞉. A꞉la꞉ wema꞉ anowo꞉ Tema. Belesa꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Heslon, Heslona꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Lam.
Lama꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Aminadab, Aminadaba꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Nason, Nasona꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Salamon.
Salamona꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Boas, a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Boasa꞉ anowo꞉ Lehab. Boasa꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Obed a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Obeda꞉ anowo꞉ Lud. Obeda꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Ya꞉si.
Ya꞉siya꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Da꞉ibid, e misa꞉ kalu alan fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Da꞉ibida꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Solomon. Solomona꞉ ano a꞉no꞉ tamin amio꞉ Ulayaya꞉ ene inga ko꞉lo꞉ elen.
Solomona꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Lehoboam, Lehoboama꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Abiya, Abiyaya꞉ ene inso꞉wo꞉ Asa,
Asaya꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Yehosafat, Yehosafata꞉ ene inso꞉wo꞉ Yeholam, Yeholama꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Usaya
Usaya ene inso꞉wo꞉ Yotam, Yotama꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Ahas, Ahasa꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Ha꞉sekaya,
Ha꞉sekaya ene inso꞉wo꞉ Manasa, Manasaya꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Amon, Amona꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Yosaya
Yosayaya꞉ ene inso꞉wo꞉ Yehoiakin o꞉lia꞉ ene ao nolo꞉lo꞉. Ho꞉len a꞉namio꞉ Babilon kalu iliyo꞉ bubo꞉wo꞉ tinia꞉sa꞉ga꞉yo꞉, Isolael kaluka꞉isaleyo꞉ Babilon ili hena a꞉ma꞉la꞉ tililia꞉gane.
A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ iyo꞉ Babilon tililia꞉gane ho꞉len a꞉namio꞉, Yehoiakin eyo꞉ ene inso꞉wo꞉ Seadiel a꞉na sa꞉la꞉li. Seadiela꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Selubabel.
Selubabela꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Abiud, Abiuda꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Eliakim, Eliakima꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Asol,
Asola꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Sadog, Sadoga꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Akim, Akima꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Eliud,
Eliuda꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Eliesa, Eliesaya꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Matan, Matana꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Ya꞉kob.
Ya꞉koba꞉ inso꞉wo꞉ Yosa꞉b, ko꞉lo꞉ Maliaya꞉ ino꞉ e. Malia eyo꞉ Ya꞉su ko꞉lo꞉ sa꞉la꞉li. Ene wiyo꞉ nowo꞉ Keliso
a꞉la꞉sio꞉.

A꞉la꞉fo꞉ko꞉lo꞉ so꞉lo꞉ agela꞉i mio꞉wo꞉, Ablahama a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Da꞉ibid elo꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉ ho꞉len a꞉namio꞉ so꞉lo꞉ agelo꞉wo꞉ do꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ fa꞉la꞉da꞉in fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Da꞉ibid eya a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Isolael kaluka꞉isale ko꞉lo꞉ Babilon hen a꞉namilo꞉ tililia꞉gane a꞉no꞉lo꞉ so꞉lo꞉ agelo꞉wo꞉ do꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ fa꞉la꞉da꞉in fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Babilon hen a꞉namilo꞉ tililia꞉gane a꞉na a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Keliso elo꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉ ho꞉len a꞉namio꞉lo꞉ so꞉lo꞉ agelo꞉wo꞉ do꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ fa꞉la꞉da꞉in fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉.
Malia eyo꞉ Ya꞉suwo꞉ sa꞉la꞉li

Ya꞉su Keliso sa꞉la꞉liyo꞉ we au fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉. Ene ano Malia a꞉no꞉ Yosa꞉bo꞉ samefo꞉len. A꞉la꞉yo꞉ semo꞉ sili alifa꞉ a꞉lab a꞉namio꞉, Godeya꞉ Mamaya꞉ halaido꞉wa a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉yo꞉ Malia e so꞉wayo꞉ alelabo꞉lo꞉b a꞉la꞉bo꞉ iyo꞉ a꞉na ba꞉ba꞉.
Elo꞉ samefo꞉len kalu Yosa꞉bo꞉ mada digalo꞉ kalu ko꞉lo꞉, eyo꞉ ga a꞉no꞉ kalab amio꞉ sendelo alifa꞉no꞉wo꞉ mo꞉asulaki, eyo꞉ ga a꞉no꞉ ha꞉sa ta꞉fa꞉no꞉ asulo꞉.

Ko꞉sega Yosa꞉b e a꞉no꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ kele asula꞉liki elen amio꞉, Kalu Alana꞉ ma꞉mul kalu nowo꞉ elo꞉ amio꞉ ofo fa꞉la꞉dowakiyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉, “Yosa꞉b gi ma꞉muwo꞉ Da꞉ibid. Giyo꞉ ga we dia꞉no꞉wo꞉ tagila꞉so꞉bo. Mo꞉wo꞉ Malia e so꞉wa sab a꞉no꞉ Godeya꞉ Mamaya꞉ eya fa꞉la꞉do alifa꞉ ko꞉lo꞉ ge tagila꞉so꞉bo.

Eyo꞉ kalu so꞉wa sa꞉la꞉lia꞉ib ko꞉lo꞉, giyo꞉ so꞉wa a꞉no꞉ wiyo꞉ Ya꞉su wikila꞉bi. A꞉la꞉do꞉ so꞉lo꞉lo꞉ mo꞉wo꞉ we. So꞉wa a꞉ma꞉yo꞉ kaluka꞉isale enedo꞉ma꞉lo꞉ mogago꞉ dimida꞉lab a꞉no꞉ halaki, iyo꞉ asuwa꞉taki a꞉ma꞉la꞉ gasilia꞉ib.” Ma꞉mul kalu eyo꞉ a꞉la꞉sio꞉.
Kelego꞉ fa꞉la꞉dowo꞉ a꞉ma꞉yo꞉, tamin amilo꞉ Kalu Alana꞉lo꞉ ene tolo꞉ dinali sa꞉lan kaluwa a꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉lo꞉ sio꞉ a꞉no꞉ kolo꞉ ilili alitakigab. Dinali sio꞉ to a꞉no꞉ we.

content.text: “Ga we, kalu o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ mo꞉ali amio꞉ so꞉wayo꞉ alela꞉sa꞉ga꞉, kalu so꞉wa sa꞉la꞉lia꞉ib ko꞉lo꞉,

content: To wema꞉ ha꞉go꞉ we, Godeyo꞉ ni o꞉lia꞉ dofo꞉lab.
Yosa꞉b e dasilia꞉ga꞉yo꞉, Alana꞉ ene ma꞉mul kaluwa꞉lo꞉ to saefa꞉ o꞉leauka kudu ane. Eyo꞉ Maliayo꞉ ene aya tililia꞉ga꞉ ane,
ko꞉sega Malia eyo꞉ sowa꞉yo꞉ semo꞉ sa꞉la꞉li amio꞉, Yosa꞉b e Malia o꞉lia꞉yo꞉ do꞉mo꞉ imiligo꞉ modo꞉wo꞉. A꞉la꞉ta꞉ga꞉ Malia eyo꞉ kalu so꞉wa a꞉no꞉ sa꞉la꞉liabikiyo꞉, Yosa꞉b eyo꞉ so꞉wa a꞉no꞉ Ya꞉su wikilo꞉.

footnotes.text: 1.16 Keliso a꞉la꞉do꞉ sa꞉lab a꞉ma꞉ ha꞉go꞉ we, Gode eyo꞉ kaluka꞉isalelo꞉ gasilia꞉no꞉ da꞉feyo꞉ kaluwo꞉ we.
